commands.summary: Opens the offline help browser (command pages, tutorials, shortcuts); F1 opens the running command's page.

commands.name: TUTORIALS
commands.summary: Opens the step-by-step tutorials and the sample project in the help browser.

commands.name: SAMPLEHOUSE
commands.summary: Opens the bundled sample house project in a new window.

commands.name: SELECTWALLCHAIN
commands.summary: Selects the chain of walls joined to a picked wall (Tab over a wall does the same).
entries: Tools ▸ Navigation & Sheets ▸ Select Wall Chain

commands.name: DVIEW
commands.summary: Rotates (twists) the 2D plan display; model coordinates are unchanged. DVIEW TWist 30, DVIEW Off.

commands.name: PERSPECTIVE
commands.summary: 3D projection: 1 = perspective, 0 = parallel (orthographic).

commands.name: VPMAX
commands.summary: Maximises a sheet viewport: edits the model through it at full window size (VPMIN returns).

commands.name: VPMIN
commands.summary: Returns from a maximised viewport to its sheet, keeping the new view centre (unless the viewport is locked).

commands.name: VPCLIP
commands.summary: Clips a sheet viewport to a polygon of paper points (x,y in mm), or Deletes the clip.

commands.name: MVIEWPOLY
commands.summary: Creates a polygonal sheet viewport from paper points (x,y in mm) showing the current level.

commands.name: MVSETUP
commands.summary: Aligns sheet viewports: pans one viewport so a model point lines up horizontally or vertically with a point in another.

commands.name: SHEETGRID
commands.summary: Guide grid on the current sheet (spacing in paper mm, 0 = off); viewports snap to it when moved.
entries: Tools ▸ Navigation & Sheets ▸ Sheet Guide Grid

commands.name: SHEETPLACEHOLDER
commands.summary: Adds a placeholder sheet (listed in the sheet set and index, never plotted) or toggles the current one.

commands.name: SHEETFIELD
commands.summary: Custom title block fields: Project fields appear on every sheet, Sheet fields override them on one sheet.

commands.name: VISUALSTYLES
commands.summary: Visual styles manager: New/Edit a custom style from a base (edges, edge colour, face opacity, shadows, background), Delete, List, Current.
entries: Tools ▸ Navigation & Sheets ▸ Visual Styles Manager

commands.name: TILEDVIEWS
commands.summary: Tiled model views: 2, 3 or 4 views (plan, 3D, section, elevations), each with its own zoom and pan.

commands.name: PLOTAREA
commands.summary: Model-space plot area (Extents/Display/Limits/Window) and fit (Standard scale or Exact) for PLOT, PREVIEW and PDF export.

commands.name: SHEETSVG
commands.summary: Exports the current sheet (or All sheets) as true-size vector SVG with one layer per drawing layer.
entries: Tools ▸ Navigation & Sheets ▸ Sheet to SVG

commands.name: PLOTSTYLENAME
commands.summary: Named plot styles (STB): assign a style to a Layer or to Objects, choose the Table used by the current sheet (or model), or List styles.
entries: Tools ▸ Navigation & Sheets ▸ Named Plot Styles

commands.name: EXPORTSETTINGS
commands.summary: Exports all preferences (theme, shortcuts, toolbar, workspaces, snippets…) to a .plist file for another Mac.

commands.name: IMPORTSETTINGS
commands.summary: Imports preferences exported by EXPORTSETTINGS (restart to apply everything).

commands.name: WINDOWTABS
commands.summary: Native window tabs: Merge all drawing windows into tabs, or open new drawings in Tabs / Windows.

commands.name: FULLSCREEN
commands.summary: Enters or leaves full screen for this drawing window (⌃⌘F).

commands.name: LWDISPLAYSCALE
commands.summary: Screen display scale of lineweights (0.1–5, default 1); plotted widths are never changed.
entries: Tools ▸ Navigation & Sheets ▸ Lineweight Display Scale

commands.name: PSETUPIN
commands.summary: Imports a page setup (plot style, colour mode, lineweights, stamp, paper) from another drawing into the current sheet or all sheets.
entries: Tools ▸ Navigation & Sheets ▸ Import Page Setup

commands.name: MARKUPPANEL
commands.summary: Opens the markup/issue panel: filter open/resolved, reply, resolve, zoom to, link to the selection, BCF.

commands.name: COMPAREPANEL
commands.summary: Compares with another version and draws the differences over the plan (added green, removed red, modified yellow).

commands.name: REVCLOUDPANEL
commands.summary: Sheet revision clouds: add a cloud with a revision triangle around a viewport or an area of a sheet, list, open, delete.

commands.name: BLOCKPALETTE
commands.summary: Block library panel: library folders with thumbnails, search, favourites and recents; drag blocks onto the drawing.

commands.name: MEASURE3D
commands.summary: Measures in the 3D view: click two points on the model for distance and ΔX/ΔY/ΔZ.

commands.name: GIZMO3D
commands.summary: Shows a move (X/Y/Z arrows), rotate (ring) or uniform scale gizmo on the selection in the 3D view; drag it to transform (one undo step).

commands.name: CAMERAPATHEDIT
commands.summary: Camera path editor: keys from the 3D view or saved cameras at times, timeline scrubbing and playback, video export.

commands.name: RENDERQUEUE
commands.summary: Render queue: add the current view or saved cameras, render them in turn to PNG files; render history with thumbnails.

commands.name: CLIPPLANES
commands.summary: Clipping plane panel in the 3D view: horizontal or vertical cut, live offset slider, flip, remove.

commands.name: SHARE
commands.summary: Shares the drawing through the macOS share sheet (Mail, Messages, AirDrop, Notes…): Project (.archi), Pdf of the drawing or active sheet, or Both.

commands.name: PRINTSETUP
commands.summary: Prints with printer, paper, tray (input slot), media, scaling (fit, 1:1, percent) and copies.

commands.name: PATHTRACE
commands.summary: Progressive path-traced render of the 3D view (GGX materials, glass refraction, PBR maps, sun, sky, lights): Window, or File with size, samples and denoising.
entries: Tools ▸ Render, Materials & Environment ▸ Path Tracer

commands.name: LIGHTMIX
commands.summary: Light mix of path-traced renders: weights of the Sun, Sky and Artificial light groups, changeable after rendering (saved in the drawing).
entries: Tools ▸ Render, Materials & Environment ▸ Light Mix

commands.name: MATMAPS
commands.summary: PBR texture maps of a material: Normal, Roughness, Metallic, AO and Displacement images, normal strength and displacement height; List/Clear.
entries: Tools ▸ Render, Materials & Environment ▸ PBR Maps

commands.name: MATASSET
commands.summary: Material assets kept apart from the render appearance: Identity (description, manufacturer, mark, cost), Graphics (shading colour, surface pattern) and Physical/thermal (density, conductivity, specific heat); List.
entries: Tools ▸ Render, Materials & Environment ▸ Material Assets

commands.name: PROCMATERIAL
commands.summary: Procedural seamless material (Wood, Brick, Tile, Marble, Stone, Concrete, Terrazzo) with albedo, normal and roughness maps from colours, courses, joint width and a seed.
entries: Tools ▸ Render, Materials & Environment ▸ Procedural Material

commands.name: MATFROMIMAGE
commands.summary: Creates a seamless PBR material from a photo: de-lit albedo, normal, roughness and AO maps derived from the image, at a real-world tile size.
entries: Tools ▸ Render, Materials & Environment ▸ Material from Photo

commands.name: WEATHER
commands.summary: Weather in the 3D view and renders: Clear, Rain, Snow or Fog with an intensity, snow cover on up-facing faces and wet surfaces.

commands.name: SEASON
commands.summary: Season of the vegetation in the 3D view and renders: Spring, Summer, Autumn or Winter colours for grass, trees and plants.

commands.name: WATER
commands.summary: Water surface with animated waves (viewport and renders) inside a closed polyline or picked points, at a surface elevation and depth.

commands.name: SCATTER
commands.summary: Scatters Grass, Flowers, Shrubs or Trees over closed boundaries with Poisson-disk spacing at a density per m² (reproducible seed); shown in the viewport and renders.
entries: Tools ▸ Render, Materials & Environment ▸ Scatter Plants

commands.name: ANIMATE
commands.summary: Object animation saved in the drawing: Door swings, Rotate about a pivot, Move by a vector (start time, duration, there and back); Play/Stop in 3D, List, Delete, Clear, Render a frame.
entries: Tools ▸ Render, Materials & Environment ▸ Animate Objects

commands.name: NODEPACKAGE
commands.summary: Custom node packages (.archinodes): Create one from the drawing's node graph (a snippet per group), Install a file, Insert a snippet into the graph, List, Remove.
entries: Tools ▸ Render, Materials & Environment ▸ Node Packages

commands.name: CUSTOMIZERPANEL
commands.summary: Customizer panel: sliders, check boxes and choices for the parameters of the selected scripted object (OpenSCAD customizer comments), regenerating it on change.
entries: Tools ▸ Render, Materials & Environment ▸ Customizer Panel

commands.name: REDRAW
commands.summary: Refreshes the screen from the display cache (fast; REGEN rebuilds the cache).

commands.name: GRAPHICSTYLES
commands.summary: Graphic styles manager: line styles and their layers, lineweights by view scale, pen sets and graphic override filters in one dialog.
entries: Tools ▸ Render, Materials & Environment ▸ Graphic Styles

commands.name: SPACEMOUSE
commands.summary: 3Dconnexion SpaceMouse: On/Off, Object (orbit) or Fly mode, Sensitivity, Status. Axes move the 3D camera; button 1 fits the view.

commands.name: CUI
commands.summary: Customizes the ribbon: Dialog, Add a panel of commands to a tab, Remove, Hide/Show a built-in panel, List, Export/Import a customisation file, Reset.
entries: Tools ▸ Render, Materials & Environment ▸ Customize Ribbon

commands.name: ARQUICKLOOK
commands.summary: AR Quick Look: exports the model as a real-scale USDZ and Previews it or Shares it to an iPhone/iPad (AirDrop) to place it in AR.
entries: Tools ▸ Render, Materials & Environment ▸ AR Quick Look

commands.name: FILEVERSIONS
commands.summary: macOS Versions of the saved file (every save keeps one): Browse window, List, Restore a version, Open a copy, Save a version now, Keep count.
entries: Tools ▸ Files, Clipboard & Access ▸ Browse Versions

commands.name: FILEPREVIEW
commands.summary: Finder preview icon and Spotlight metadata of the saved drawing: Update now, Icons on/off, Versions on/off, Show the indexed metadata.
entries: Tools ▸ Files, Clipboard & Access ▸ File Preview & Spotlight

commands.name: PASTESPECIAL
commands.summary: Pastes what another app copied — SVG or PDF vectors, pictures, DXF text, plain text or Finder files — at an insertion point.
entries: Tools ▸ Files, Clipboard & Access ▸ Paste from Other App

commands.name: COPYPICTURE
commands.summary: Copies the selected objects (or the whole drawing) to the clipboard as a vector PDF and a PNG picture for other apps.
entries: Tools ▸ Files, Clipboard & Access ▸ Copy as Picture

commands.name: ZOOMXP
commands.summary: ZOOM nXP: in a sheet sets the selected viewport to 1:n (1/100XP); on the plan shows the drawing at that paper scale at true size on the screen.
entries: Tools ▸ Files, Clipboard & Access ▸ Zoom to Paper Scale

commands.name: OUTLINERPANEL
commands.summary: Outliner window: the tree of groups, components, blocks and model groups; click selects, double-click zooms, filter by name.

commands.name: SPEAKDRAWING
commands.summary: Describes the drawing, the selection and the current prompt (spoken by VoiceOver, printed on the command line).
entries: Tools ▸ Files, Clipboard & Access ▸ Describe Drawing

commands.name: KEYBOARDNAV
commands.summary: Keyboard-only drawing: arrow keys move the crosshair at prompts (Shift ×10, Option ÷10; Option-arrows when idle), Return picks, Tab selects under the crosshair; sets the step.
entries: Tools ▸ Files, Clipboard & Access ▸ Keyboard Navigation

commands.name: MECHANISMPLAY
commands.summary: Animates a mechanism on the plan: steps a named driving dimension through a range (re-solving the constraints) and plays the poses Once, in a Loop or Bounce; Stop ends it. The drawing is not changed.
entries: Tools ▸ Files, Clipboard & Access ▸ Play Mechanism

commands.name: OBJECTSTYLESDIALOG
commands.summary: Object Styles dialog: projection/cut line weights, line colour, cut fill and cut pattern per BIM category for every plan and section.
entries: Tools ▸ Styles, Patterns & Occlusion ▸ Object Styles…

commands.name: TEXTSTYLEDIALOG
commands.summary: Text Style manager: font, height, width factor and oblique angle with a live preview; renaming a style updates its text.
entries: Tools ▸ Styles, Patterns & Occlusion ▸ Text Styles…

commands.name: IMAGEADJUSTDIALOG
commands.summary: Image Adjust dialog: brightness, contrast and fade of the selected raster images with a preview (exact on screen and in PDF plots).
entries: Tools ▸ Styles, Patterns & Occlusion ▸ Image Adjust…

commands.name: AODIALOG
commands.summary: Ambient Occlusion dialog: intensity, radius and rays per point for the 3D viewport, renders and shaded views.
entries: Tools ▸ Styles, Patterns & Occlusion ▸ Ambient Occlusion…

commands.name: TEXTEDITINPLACE
commands.summary: In-place text editor on the canvas: bold, italic, underline, font, height and colour (also opened by double-clicking text); exported to PDF and DXF MTEXT.
entries: Tools ▸ Styles, Patterns & Occlusion ▸ Edit Text In Place

commands.name: VRVIEW
commands.summary: VR headset viewing: writes the model as a WebXR page (life-size, floor on the room floor, pinch/trigger steps forward) for Apple Vision Pro, Meta Quest or OpenXR browsers; Open, Reveal (AirDrop) or just Save.
entries: Tools ▸ Styles, Patterns & Occlusion ▸ VR Headset View

commands.name: CRASHREPORTS
commands.summary: Opt-in crash reports: On, Off, Status, Show the saved reports (reviewed and sent only by you), Clear.
entries: Tools ▸ Styles, Patterns & Occlusion ▸ Crash Reports

commands.name: MATPATTERNDIALOG
commands.summary: Material Fill Patterns dialog: cut and surface pattern of every material; bound hatches and floor patterns update.
entries: Tools ▸ Styles, Patterns & Occlusion ▸ Material Fill Patterns…

commands.name: FLY
commands.summary: Free flight in 3D: W A S D along the view direction, Q/E down/up, drag to look (no gravity or collisions).

commands.name: LOOKAROUND
commands.summary: Looks around from the current eye point (drag or arrow keys turn the head; the camera does not move).
entries: Tools ▸ Navigate, Light & Publish ▸ Look Around

commands.name: POSITIONCAMERA
commands.summary: Places the camera at a plan point at eye height looking towards a second point, then looks around (SketchUp style).
entries: Tools ▸ Navigate, Light & Publish ▸ Position Camera

commands.name: TWOPOINT
commands.summary: Two-point perspective: levels the 3D camera so vertical lines stay vertical, shifting the lens to keep the framing (On/Off).
entries: Tools ▸ Navigate, Light & Publish ▸ Two-Point Perspective

commands.name: NAVSWHEEL
commands.summary: Steering wheel in 3D: Zoom, Orbit, Pan, Rewind (outer ring), Center, Walk, Up/Down, Look (inner ring).
entries: Tools ▸ Navigate, Light & Publish ▸ Steering Wheel

commands.name: LIGHT
commands.summary: Places point, spot, area, line or IES lights (lumens, colour temperature, beam) that light the 3D view and renders; List, On/Off.

commands.name: FOG
commands.summary: Fog / atmospheric haze in the 3D view and renders: On/Off, start and end distance, colour and falloff (saved in the drawing).

commands.name: MATEMISSIVE
commands.summary: Makes a material self-illuminated (luminance factor 0–20; 0 turns it off): screens, lamps, signs glow in 3D and renders.
entries: Tools ▸ Navigate, Light & Publish ▸ Emissive Material

commands.name: MATMAPPING
commands.summary: Texture mapping of a material: Box, Planar, Cylindrical, Spherical or UV, and texture positioning (offset, rotation, scale) on its faces; Reset.
entries: Tools ▸ Navigate, Light & Publish ▸ Texture Mapping

commands.name: BILLBOARD
commands.summary: Places a 2D cutout that always faces the camera in 3D and renders: Person, Tree, Shrub or an image file (PNG with transparency).

commands.name: EXPORTPDF
commands.summary: Vector PDF with one PDF layer (OCG) per drawing layer, searchable text and hyperlinks: current sheet, model or all sheets, at true scale.
entries: Tools ▸ Navigate, Light & Publish ▸ Export PDF

commands.name: TITLEBLOCKDESIGN
commands.summary: Custom title blocks: Create a starter block (edit it with BEDIT: lines, logo images, {field} texts or attributes), Use a block on all or the current sheet, or go back to the Builtin one.
entries: Tools ▸ Navigate, Light & Publish ▸ Title Block Design

commands.name: SHADEPLOT
commands.summary: Shade plot of a 3D (axonometric / perspective) sheet viewport: As Displayed, Wireframe, Hidden or Rendered, and the saved 3D view it shows.
entries: Tools ▸ Navigate, Light & Publish ▸ Shade Plot

commands.name: WEBVIEWEREXPORT
commands.summary: Exports the 3D model as one standalone HTML file with a WebGL viewer (orbit, pan, zoom, views) that opens in any browser.
entries: Tools ▸ Navigate, Light & Publish ▸ Web Viewer Export

commands.name: RENDERTOFILE
commands.summary: Renders to an image file: any size up to 7680×4320 (tiled), a pass (Beauty, Alpha, Depth, Normal, Material ID), a style (Photographic, Sketch, Watercolour) and an optional region of the frame.
entries: Tools ▸ Navigate, Light & Publish ▸ Render to File (Passes, Region, 8K)

commands.name: STEREOPANORAMA
commands.summary: Stereo 360° panorama for VR viewers: left and right eye equirectangular images over-under (omni-directional stereo), from the 3D camera or a plan point.
entries: Tools ▸ Navigate, Light & Publish ▸ Stereo 360° Panorama

commands.name: PHASEANIMATION
commands.summary: Construction sequence (4D) video from the phases (new elements appear bottom-up, demolished ones disappear) or from the work schedule (day by day), captioned (MP4).
entries: Tools ▸ Navigate, Light & Publish ▸ Construction Sequence (4D)

commands.name: HYPERLINK
commands.summary: Attaches a URL (web page or file) to objects; exported PDFs make them clickable. Empty removes the link.

commands.name: ASSISTANT
commands.summary: AI assistant panel: Claude or a local model (Ollama) edits the drawing with commands; bulk changes ask for confirmation; everything is undoable.
entries: Tools ▸ Navigate, Light & Publish ▸ AI Assistant

commands.name: RENDERPROMPT
commands.summary: Styles the render from a description (e.g. “golden hour, soft shadows, warm, 4K”): saves it as the “Prompt” render preset and opens the render window.
entries: Tools ▸ Navigate, Light & Publish ▸ Render Prompt

commands.name: GRAPHPLAYER
commands.summary: Graph player: runs a saved node graph with its exposed Number inputs (clamped to their ranges) and bakes the result; Window opens the player panel.
entries: Tools ▸ Navigate, Light & Publish ▸ Graph Player

commands.name: SYSWINDOWS
commands.summary: Arranges the open drawing windows: Vertical (side by side), Horizontal, Cascade, Tabs or Separate windows.
entries: Tools ▸ Navigate, Light & Publish ▸ Arrange Windows

commands.name: RADIALMENU
commands.summary: Right-drag marking menu with the 8 most used commands for the context (On/Off/List).
entries: Tools ▸ Navigate, Light & Publish ▸ Radial Menu

commands.name: FAMILYPANEL
commands.summary: Family Editor panel: families list, parameters and formulas, forms, types table, reference planes, profiles, live 3D preview and flex; Apply is one undo step.
entries: Tools ▸ Families, Views & Panels ▸ Family Editor Panel

commands.name: MOVEZ
commands.summary: Moves objects up or down: element base/top offsets and door/window sills change, solids move (one undo step).
entries: Tools ▸ Families, Views & Panels ▸ Move Up/Down (Z)

commands.name: LEVELVIEW3D
commands.summary: 3D view by level: show All levels, Isolate one level, or Explode levels apart by a gap.
entries: Tools ▸ Families, Views & Panels ▸ Levels in 3D

commands.name: FOV
commands.summary: Sets the 3D camera field of view in degrees (15–120), or a Lens length in mm (35 mm equivalent).
entries: Tools ▸ Families, Views & Panels ▸ Field of View

commands.name: VIEWIMAGE
commands.summary: Saves the 3D view as a PNG, JPEG or TIFF at a chosen size, optionally with a transparent background.
entries: Tools ▸ Families, Views & Panels ▸ Save 3D View Image

commands.name: SHEETIMAGE
commands.summary: Exports a sheet (layout) or the Model view of the current level as a PNG, JPEG or TIFF image at a chosen resolution (dpi).
entries: Tools ▸ Families, Views & Panels ▸ Sheet to Image

commands.name: SELECTIONINFO
commands.summary: Selection info panel: count and types of the selected objects, layers, total length/area, keep-only/remove filters.
entries: Tools ▸ Families, Views & Panels ▸ Selection Info

commands.name: NOTIFICATIONS
commands.summary: Notifications centre: model warnings (overlaps, unhosted openings, family errors, missing blocks) — click one to zoom to it.

commands.name: NAVIGATOR
commands.summary: Navigator: overview map of the whole drawing with the visible area; drag the rectangle to pan.

commands.name: WHATSNEW
commands.summary: Shows what is new in this version (also shown once after an update).
entries: Tools ▸ Families, Views & Panels ▸ What's New

commands.name: APPSELFTEST
commands.summary: Runs the app's built-in regression checks (node graph, sheet set, presets, clipboard, ribbon).
entries: Manage ▸ More ▸ Tools ▸ Help ▸ Self Test

commands.name: RENDERPRESET
commands.summary: Photographic lighting preset of the Realistic view and renders: Daylight, Golden hour, Overcast or Night (glowing windows); Off returns to the default look.
entries: Tools ▸ Photographic Render ▸ Golden Hour Look

commands.name: RENDERSAVE
commands.summary: Renders offscreen to a PNG without the render window: RENDERSAVE <preset> <camera|Current> <width> <height> <path> (4× MSAA + supersampling, vertical correction for eye-level cameras).
entries: Tools ▸ Photographic Render ▸ Render to PNG

commands.name: CMDLINEOPTIONS
commands.summary: Command line appearance: text Size, history Lines shown, background Opacity; Float it over the canvas or Dock it at the bottom.
entries: Tools ▸ Render, Materials & Environment ▸ Command Line Options

commands.name: LANGUAGE
commands.summary: Interface language of the ribbon: Auto (macOS), English, Română, Deutsch, Français, Español, Italiano. Commands stay English.

commands.name: TUTORIALRECORD
commands.summary: Tutorial videos: plays the scripted tutorials (tutorials/*.tut) in a new window and records each as an MP4 with cursor, captions and typed keys; List, Record or Check (dry run).
entries: Tools ▸ Tutorial Videos ▸ Check Tutorial Scripts
Tools ▸ Tutorial Videos ▸ Record Tutorial Videos

commands.name: DAYLIGHTANNUAL
commands.summary: Climate-based daylight per room from an EPW weather file (or a clear-sky year): spatial daylight autonomy sDA300/50% and annual sunlight exposure ASE1000,250h (IES LM-83), optionally drawing the work-plane grid coloured by autonomy.

commands.name: CFDEXPORT
commands.summary: Writes an OpenFOAM wind-study case (simpleFoam, atmospheric boundary layer inlet, snappyHexMesh around the building, pedestrian-level sampling) for the given wind speed and direction.
entries: Tools ▸ Analysis & Generative ▸ Wind Study Export (CFD)

commands.name: WINDRESULTS
commands.summary: Imports an OpenFOAM pedestrian-level velocity sample (raw x y z Ux Uy Uz) as wind arrows coloured by speed with Lawson comfort classes (the case's wind direction is taken from WINDDIRECTION); the Solve option runs the built-in 2D lattice Boltzmann solver instead (no external CFD needed).

commands.name: GENDESIGN
commands.summary: Generative design: optimises floor layouts for a room programme and gross area with a genetic algorithm (daylight, proportions, adjacencies, orientation, compactness); lists the Pareto-optimal designs and builds the chosen one after confirmation.

commands.name: SKETCHTOWALLS
commands.summary: Converts a scanned or photographed plan image (PNG/BMP/PGM) into walls: dark strokes within a thickness range become wall centre lines at a given scale; asks for confirmation before creating them (one undo step).
entries: Tools ▸ Analysis & Generative ▸ Sketch to Walls

commands.name: TAKEOFF
commands.summary: Quantity takeoff: wall areas/volumes (net of openings) per type and material, slabs, roofs, columns, beams, door/window counts; optional CSV.

commands.name: COSTESTIMATE
commands.summary: Cost estimate from the takeoff and unit rates (UNITPRICE drawing rates or a JSON table); optional CSV.

commands.name: UNITPRICE
commands.summary: Stores a unit rate in the drawing (COST:<category>[:<type>]:<measure>) used by COSTESTIMATE.

commands.name: ROOMSCHEDULE
commands.summary: Room area schedule with net (minus columns) and gross (to wall centre lines) areas, perimeter and volume; optional CSV.

commands.name: SUNPOSITION
commands.summary: Sun azimuth/altitude, sunrise and sunset for a date, time and the project location; stores SUNAZIMUTH/SUNALTITUDE.

commands.name: CLASHDETECT
commands.summary: Finds hard clashes between elements and 3D solids (touching and hosted/joined elements are ignored); lists, selects and zooms.

commands.name: CHECKMODEL
commands.summary: Checks the model: walls without height, openings wider than or outside their host, overlapping/duplicate walls and rooms, unnamed or duplicate rooms, missing levels.

commands.name: UVALUE
commands.summary: U-value (EN ISO 6946) of selected walls, slabs, roofs and openings from their layers; Lambda sets a material's conductivity, Set a type's U-value.
entries: Analyze ▸ Building Physics ▸ More ▸ Analysis & Checks ▸ U-Value

commands.name: HEATLOSS
commands.summary: Design heat loss of the envelope (U·A·ΔT of exterior walls, windows, doors, roofs, ground floor) plus ventilation, and annual heating demand; optional CSV.
entries: Analyze ▸ Building Physics ▸ More ▸ Analysis & Checks ▸ Heat Loss

commands.name: DAYLIGHT
commands.summary: Average daylight factor of each room from its windows (BRE formula: T·Aw·θ·M / A(1−R²)) and the window-to-floor ratio; optional CSV.
entries: Analyze ▸ Building Physics ▸ More ▸ Analysis & Checks ▸ Daylight

commands.name: SUNPATH
commands.summary: Draws a polar sun path diagram (altitude rings, compass, the day's path with hours, solstices/equinox) for a date at the project location.
entries: Analyze ▸ Building Physics ▸ More ▸ Analysis & Checks ▸ Sun Path

commands.name: LEVELAREAS
commands.summary: Area schedule by level: gross floor area (slabs, a 'gross' area plan or rooms) and net room area with the net/gross ratio; optional CSV.
entries: Analyze ▸ Building Physics ▸ More ▸ Analysis & Checks ▸ Level Areas

commands.name: ANALYTICALMODEL
commands.summary: Builds the structural analytical model (nodes, members, wall/slab panels, supports, loads) from columns, beams, walls and slabs and writes it as JSON, OpenSees Tcl, SAF (.xlsx) or an IFC4 structural analysis view (.ifc).
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ Structure ▸ Analytical Model

commands.name: FRAMEANALYSIS
commands.summary: Linear static analysis of the column/beam frame (self weight + slab loads lumped to columns): displacements and support reactions.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ Structure ▸ Frame Analysis

commands.name: CODECHECK
commands.summary: Checks rooms (area, height, width, window-to-floor ratio), stairs (riser, tread, 2R+T, width, flight), ramps and doors against JSON code rules (CODERULES or a file); lists, selects and zooms.
entries: Analyze ▸ Building Physics ▸ More ▸ Analysis & Checks ▸ Code Check

commands.name: CODERULES
commands.summary: Stores code rules in the drawing from a JSON file (Load), writes the current rules to a file (Save) or restores the defaults.
entries: Analyze ▸ Building Physics ▸ More ▸ Analysis & Checks ▸ Code Rules

commands.name: REVERB
commands.summary: Reverberation time (Sabine RT60 at 500 Hz) of each room from its volume and surface absorption; optional CSV.
entries: Analyze ▸ Building Physics ▸ More ▸ Analysis & Checks ▸ Reverberation

commands.name: CARBON
commands.summary: Embodied carbon (A1–A3, kgCO2e) of the model's materials from takeoff volumes, densities and carbon factors (CARBON:/DENSITY: overrides); optional CSV.
entries: Analyze ▸ Building Physics ▸ More ▸ Analysis & Checks ▸ Embodied Carbon

commands.name: ISOVIST
commands.summary: Draws the isovist (area visible from a point at eye height, walls block, doors and openings are see-through) and reports its area.
entries: Analyze ▸ Building Physics ▸ More ▸ Analysis & Checks ▸ Isovist

commands.name: IFCVALIDATE
commands.summary: Validates an IFC file (or the model's own IFC export): syntax, schema header, references, GlobalIds, attribute counts, project/units, spatial containment.
entries: Analyze ▸ Building Physics ▸ More ▸ Analysis & Checks ▸ Validate IFC

commands.name: STANDARDSCHECK
commands.summary: Checks layers (naming pattern, required layers, objects on layer 0), ByLayer properties, text heights/styles and linetypes against a JSON drawing standard (DRAWINGSTANDARDS variable or a file); lists, selects and zooms.
entries: Analyze ▸ Building Physics ▸ More ▸ Analysis & Checks ▸ Standards Check

commands.name: SOLARRADIATION
commands.summary: Clear-sky solar irradiation (kWh/m² per day) on exterior walls, windows and roofs for a date at the project location; optional CSV.
entries: Analyze ▸ Building Physics ▸ More ▸ Analysis & Checks ▸ Solar Radiation

commands.name: LOADTAKEDOWN
commands.summary: Structural load takedown per column: tributary slab areas, dead (self weight + LOADSDL) and imposed loads by room usage, accumulated down the stacked columns, ULS 1.35G+1.5Q, SLS and axial stress; optional CSV.

commands.name: RAINWATER
commands.summary: Rainwater from roofs: plan area incl. overhangs, runoff coefficient, design flow Q = C·i·A, downpipes (EN 12056-3 capacities), gutter length and annual harvest; optional CSV.

commands.name: PARKINGCHECK
commands.summary: Parking provision check: required spaces from room usage and area (PARKINGRULES, e.g. office=35;apartment=unit:1) against the parking spaces placed, including accessible spaces.

commands.name: FIRECOMPARTMENTS
commands.summary: Fire compartments: room areas grouped by prop fireCompartment (else per level) against FIREMAXAREA (doubled with FIRESPRINKLERS=1), and walls between compartments below FIRERATINGREQ minutes; selects failing walls.

commands.name: ISSUETRACKER
commands.summary: Issue tracker stored in the drawing: Add (linked to the selection), List, Show, Status, Assign, Priority, Comment, Zoom, Delete and Csv export.

commands.name: TLEN
commands.summary: Total length of the selected lines, arcs, circles, polylines, splines and ellipses (and wall lengths).

commands.name: ANGLEBETWEEN
commands.summary: Angle between two lines (or vertex + two points).

commands.name: DISTTOOBJECT
commands.summary: Shortest distance from a point to an object.
entries: Tools ▸ Inquiry Extras ▸ Distance to Object

commands.name: POINTINSIDE
commands.summary: Tells whether a point is inside, outside or on a closed contour (polyline, circle, ellipse, hatch, room, slab).

commands.name: CLASHMANAGE
commands.summary: Manages clash results kept in the drawing: Run (detect; disappeared clashes become resolved), List, Group (Type/Level/Proximity), Status, Assign, Zoom to a clash (selects both elements), Csv export.

commands.name: COLORBLINDCHECK
commands.summary: Checks layer colours for colour-blind safety (protanopia, deuteranopia, tritanopia; CIEDE2000) against the background; Fix re-colours the conflicting layers from the Okabe–Ito palette.
entries: Tools ▸ Studies, Signatures & Publishing ▸ Colour-Blind Check

commands.name: AUTODIMPLAN
commands.summary: Dimensions the current level's plan automatically: exterior chains on all four sides (openings, walls, overall) on layer A-ANNO-DIMS; asks before adding them (one undo step).
entries: Tools ▸ Analysis & Design Assist ▸ Auto-Dimension Plan

commands.name: AUTONAMEROOMS
commands.summary: Names and numbers rooms of the current level from their fixtures (toilet, bath, bed, kitchen…), shape, windows and doors; Unnamed only or All; lists the suggestions and asks before applying (one undo step).
entries: Tools ▸ Analysis & Design Assist ▸ Auto-Name Rooms

commands.name: QAASSIST
commands.summary: Model QA assistant: explains each model-checker finding (why it matters, what to do), Zoom to one, or Fix one / all fixable issues automatically after confirmation (one undo step).
entries: Tools ▸ Analysis & Design Assist ▸ QA Assistant

commands.name: TIME
commands.summary: Shows the drawing's creation and last-update dates, total editing time (idle gaps over 5 minutes excluded) and the user elapsed timer; ON/OFF/Reset control the timer.

commands.name: ENERGYPLUS
commands.summary: EnergyPlus simulation: Export an IDF (rooms as zones, envelope surfaces, windows, layered constructions, ideal-loads HVAC, location) or Run an installed EnergyPlus on it with an EPW weather file: site energy, EUI, end uses, unmet hours and per-room heating/cooling energy and peak loads (written to the rooms).
entries: Tools ▸ Analysis & Design Assist ▸ EnergyPlus Export

commands.name: MEMORYREPORT
commands.summary: Memory estimate of the drawing by kind, the app's memory footprint and the budget (MEMORYBUDGET MB) with advice; POINTLIMIT follows the budget.
entries: Tools ▸ Studies, Signatures & Publishing ▸ Memory Report

commands.name: ASK
commands.summary: Natural-language request, e.g. "draw a 4 m wall north of grid A", "add a door 900 wide in the middle of the last wall", "move the selection 2 m east": shows what was understood and asks before applying (one undo step).
entries: Tools ▸ Analysis & Design Assist ▸ Ask (Natural Language)

commands.name: PLANGEN
commands.summary: Generates floor plan options from a room programme ("Living 25, Kitchen 12, Bedroom 14 x2, Bath 6, Hall 8" in m²) inside a W × D footprint: lists scored options, builds the chosen one (walls, rooms, doors, windows) after confirmation, one undo step.
entries: Tools ▸ Analysis & Design Assist ▸ Generate Plan

commands.name: DAYLIGHTRADIANCE
commands.summary: Climate-based daylight with Radiance: Export a Radiance study (scene, materials, room sensors, sky, run.sh for the daylight-coefficient method with an EPW) or Import its results as sDA300/50% and ASE1000,250h per room (IES LM-83).
entries: Tools ▸ Studies, Signatures & Publishing ▸ Radiance Daylight

commands.name: COMPARE
commands.summary: Compares the drawing with another version (.archi, .dxf, .ifc…) by object id and geometry: added, removed and modified objects; optional colour-coded overlay file (green added, red removed, yellow modified) and CSV report.

commands.name: MARKUP
commands.summary: Review markups stored in the drawing: Add (cloud + comment with author/date, linked to selected elements and the view), List, Resolve, Reopen, Reply, Zoom, Delete.

commands.name: BCFOUT
commands.summary: Exports the markups as BCF 2.1 topics (.bcfzip) with comments, status, camera and selected elements by IFC GlobalId.

commands.name: BCFIN
commands.summary: Imports BCF 2.x topics (.bcfzip) as markups: comments, status, viewpoint camera and selection mapped to elements by IFC GlobalId.

commands.name: EGRESS
commands.summary: Egress check: longest walking distance from each room to the nearest exit (exterior or exit=1 doors, stairs on upper levels) around walls and columns, against the limit (EGRESSMAX, m). Draws the routes on EGRESS-ROUTES.

commands.name: ACCESSIBILITY
commands.summary: Accessibility check: door clear widths (A11YDOORWIDTH, default 850 mm) and Ø1500 mm wheelchair turning circles in bathrooms clear of fixtures (A11YTURNING).

commands.name: ENERGYBALANCE
commands.summary: Seasonal heating energy balance: losses from degree days (latitude table or HDD), solar gains per window orientation, internal gains, utilisation factor; optional CSV.

commands.name: BOQ
commands.summary: Bill of quantities: takeoff items priced with unit rates (UNITPRICE rates or a JSON table), numbered by trade with subtotals, contingency (BOQCONTINGENCY %) and VAT (BOQVAT %); CSV or XLSX.
entries: Tools ▸ Checks & Quantities ▸ Bill of Quantities

commands.name: TAKEOFFPHASE
commands.summary: Quantity takeoff split by construction phase (new work and demolition) and level; optional CSV.
entries: Tools ▸ Checks & Quantities ▸ Takeoff by Phase

commands.name: SHADOWDIAGRAM
commands.summary: Shadow study for a date and times at the project location: hatched ground shadows per time on A-SHADOW-hhmm layers and/or an SVG image sequence with an animated HTML page; prints the shadow areas.
entries: Tools ▸ Studies, Signatures & Publishing ▸ Shadow Diagram

commands.name: STRUCTLOAD
commands.summary: Adds a structural load on layer S-LOADS for the analytical model: Point (kN at a node or on a beam), Line (kN/m along beams) or Area (kN/m² over an outline); vertical downward by default, optional horizontal components and load case.
entries: Tools ▸ Analysis & Design Assist ▸ Structural Loads

commands.name: STRUCTSUPPORT
commands.summary: Adds a support (boundary condition) for the analytical model at a node: Fixed, Pinned, Roller or a custom ux uy uz rx ry rz code (e.g. 111000).
entries: Tools ▸ Analysis & Design Assist ▸ Structural Supports

commands.name: THERMALBRIDGES
commands.summary: Finds geometric linear thermal bridges of the envelope (wall corners, ground and intermediate floor edges, balconies, eaves, window/door reveals, columns in exterior walls) with lengths, ψ values (PSI:<kind> overrides) and H_TB = Σψ·L; selects the elements.
entries: Tools ▸ Analysis & Design Assist ▸ Thermal Bridges

commands.name: WORKSCHEDULE
commands.summary: Construction sequencing (4D) and resources: Generate tasks from the model (by level and trade, quantity-based durations, crews), List with dates and critical path, Duration/Link to edit tasks, Simulate a date (selects the elements built by then), Resources (histogram, over-allocation, cost), Level (resource levelling), Gantt (SVG), Csv.
entries: Tools ▸ Analysis & Design Assist ▸ Work Schedule (4D)

commands.name: ADAPTIVE
commands.summary: Adaptive components driven by placement points: Place a Strut, Panel, Frame or a family using P1x…P1z, P2x… values (points typed x,y,z or picked point objects the component follows); Move a point to flex it.
entries: Tools ▸ Adaptive, Corners & Roofs ▸ Adaptive Component

commands.name: BSDD
commands.summary: buildingSMART Data Dictionary: Search classes online (or Load a saved bSDD JSON), Assign a class and its properties to elements, add a view Filter on a class, List assigned classes.
entries: Tools ▸ Adaptive, Corners & Roofs ▸ bSDD Lookup

commands.name: SLABTYPE
commands.summary: Layered floor/roof types: list, create (plies top-down), assign to slabs and roofs (thickness follows the build-up), or delete.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Authoring ▸ Slab / Roof Type
Tools ▸ BIM Authoring ▸ Slab / Roof Type

commands.name: FLOORFINISH
commands.summary: Places a floor finish layer in rooms (material, thickness, tile pattern in plan).
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Authoring ▸ Floor Finish

commands.name: WALLJOINEDIT
commands.summary: Edits a wall join: pick near a wall end, then Miter, Butt (this wall stops at the other), Square off, or Disallow the join.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Authoring ▸ Wall Join

commands.name: WALLWRAP
commands.summary: Wraps the finish layers of compound walls into door/window openings (all walls or selected walls) and around free wall Ends.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Authoring ▸ Wall Wrap

commands.name: SHAFT
commands.summary: Creates a shaft that cuts every floor and roof between a base and a top level (associative: move it and the holes follow).
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Authoring ▸ Shaft

commands.name: SLABOPENING
commands.summary: Cuts a vertical opening in one floor or roof (sketched outline; associative with its host).
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Authoring ▸ Slab Opening

commands.name: SKYLIGHT
commands.summary: Places a skylight / roof window in a roof: framed glazing in the roof plane that cuts the roof.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Authoring ▸ Skylight

commands.name: DORMER
commands.summary: Builds a dormer on a sloped roof: front and cheek walls, a gable or shed dormer roof, and the opening in the main roof.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Authoring ▸ Dormer

commands.name: ROOFEDGE
commands.summary: Adds fascia boards, gutters (profile) and soffits along the eaves of roofs.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Authoring ▸ Roof Edge

commands.name: RAILINGTYPE
commands.summary: Sets the railing type of selected railings: preset (Balusters, Glass, Cable, Bars, Wooden, Handrail) or handrail profile, baluster spacing and extensions.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Authoring ▸ Railing Type

commands.name: ELEVATOR
commands.summary: Places an elevator: car, shaft walls up to a top level and a shaft opening through the floors.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Authoring ▸ Elevator

commands.name: MODELGROUP
commands.summary: Model groups: create a named group of elements, place instances, update all instances from an edited one, list, or ungroup.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Authoring ▸ Model Group

commands.name: OPENINGTRIM
commands.summary: Sets door/window casings (architraves), an interior window board and a lintel with bearings on selected openings.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Authoring ▸ Opening Trim

commands.name: MEPPIPE
commands.summary: Draws pipes along points with elbow fittings at bends; can start at a plumbing fixture connector, slope and rise.

commands.name: DUCT
commands.summary: Draws rectangular ducts along points with flanged bends.

commands.name: CABLETRAY
commands.summary: Draws cable trays (open U-channel with rungs in plan) along points.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ MEP ▸ Cable Tray

commands.name: CONDUIT
commands.summary: Draws electrical conduit along points with elbows.

commands.name: MEPCONNECTORS
commands.summary: Lists plumbing/electrical connection points of fixtures and shows or hides them in plan.

commands.name: STEELPROFILE
commands.summary: Applies structural profiles (IPE, HEA, HEB, UPN, I/H/C/L/T, RHS/SHS/CHS, rectangular, round) to beams and columns, or lists them.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ Structure ▸ Steel Profile

commands.name: BEAMSYSTEM
commands.summary: Fills a boundary with parallel beams at a spacing (direction, size or profile, top elevation).
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ Structure ▸ Beam System

commands.name: BRACE
commands.summary: Places a diagonal brace between two plan points at a bottom and a top elevation (profile, default CHS).

commands.name: TRUSS
commands.summary: Places a Pratt, Howe, Warren or Fink truss between two bearing points (height, member width, bearing elevation).

commands.name: PARKINGLOT
commands.summary: Lays out a row (or double row with aisle) of parking bays at 90°, 60° or 45° with paving.

commands.name: SITEPATH
commands.summary: Draws a path of a given width along points as a site sub-region (draped on the toposurface).
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ Site ▸ Site Path

commands.name: SUBREGION
commands.summary: Creates a site sub-region (lawn, gravel, paving) from points or a closed object, draped on the toposurface.

commands.name: RETAININGWALL
commands.summary: Draws a cantilever retaining wall (battered stem on a footing) along points; retained side on the right of travel.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ Site ▸ Retaining Wall

commands.name: PROPERTYLINE
commands.summary: Draws property lines by points or bearings and distances; labels bearings, distances and the enclosed area.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ Site ▸ Property Line

commands.name: SPOTSLOPE
commands.summary: Places live spot slopes (arrow pointing downhill with % and 1:n) on sloped slabs, ramps, roofs and toposurfaces.
entries: Annotate ▸ More ▸ Dims ▸ Dimensions ▸ Spot Slope

commands.name: SPOTELEV
commands.summary: Places live spot elevations (slab tops, roofs, toposurface) with a leader.
entries: Annotate ▸ More ▸ Dims ▸ Dimensions ▸ Spot Elevation

commands.name: WORKSET
commands.summary: Worksets (named element sets): list, new, current, assign selection, hide/show, select members.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Data ▸ Worksets

commands.name: DESIGNOPTION
commands.summary: Design options: new set/option, add selection to an option, edit (new elements join it), view, primary, accept primary, list.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Data ▸ Design Options

commands.name: ROOMFINISH
commands.summary: Sets room floor/base/wall/ceiling finishes and places the room finish schedule.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Data ▸ Room Finishes

commands.name: COLORFILL
commands.summary: Colours rooms/areas by a parameter (name, department, area range, level, any property) and places a colour legend.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Data ▸ Color Fill Plan
Tools ▸ BIM Data ▸ Color Fill Plan

commands.name: RCP
commands.summary: Reflected ceiling plan on/off (ceilings with grids and heights, ceiling fixtures), and ceiling grid settings.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Data ▸ Reflected Ceiling

commands.name: AUTODIMWALLS
commands.summary: Automatic dimension strings along wall faces through wall ends and openings, with an overall dimension.
entries: Annotate ▸ More ▸ Dims ▸ Dimensions ▸ Dimension Walls

commands.name: OPENINGPARTS
commands.summary: Sets window mullions/transoms and door fanlights/thresholds on selected openings.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Data ▸ Opening Parts

commands.name: GRIDSYSTEM
commands.summary: Creates a rectangular grid system from spacing lists (e.g. 3*6000 4500): numbered grids along X, lettered along Y.
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Grids, Zones & Data ▸ Grid System

commands.name: RADIALGRID
commands.summary: Creates a radial grid system: centre, start angle, angular spacings (e.g. 6*15), inner radius and radial spacings; numbered radial grids and lettered arc grids.
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Grids, Zones & Data ▸ Radial Grid

commands.name: WALLFLIP
commands.summary: Flips walls: swaps the interior and exterior faces (layer order) keeping the wall, its openings and door swings in place.
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Grids, Zones & Data ▸ Flip Wall

commands.name: SPLITWALL
commands.summary: Splits a wall at a picked point (repeatable) or by Levels into one wall per storey; hosted openings follow their piece.
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Grids, Zones & Data ▸ Split Wall

commands.name: OPENINGFLIP
commands.summary: Flips doors and windows: Hand (hinge side), Facing (swing / exterior side) or Both.
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Grids, Zones & Data ▸ Flip Opening

commands.name: GLOBALPARAM
commands.summary: Global parameters: New/Set a value or =formula, Bind element dimensions (wall height, thickness, opening width…) to an expression, Unbind, List, Delete; bound elements and family formulas update when a value changes.
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Grids, Zones & Data ▸ Global Parameters

commands.name: ZONE
commands.summary: Zones: Assign rooms to a named fire/HVAC/department/security zone, Remove, List zone areas, or draw zone Outlines (rooms merged across the walls).
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Grids, Zones & Data ▸ Zone

commands.name: PSET
commands.summary: Property sets (IFC Psets): Set Pset.Property values (typed by templates), Apply a template's defaults, List an element's sets, Remove, Check values, and custom Templates (New/Add/Delete/List).
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Grids, Zones & Data ▸ Property Sets

commands.name: CLASSIFY
commands.summary: Classification codes: Auto-classify by element kind (Uniformat II, NL-SfB), Set a code in any system (Uniclass 2015, OmniClass…), List, Clear.
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Grids, Zones & Data ▸ Classify

commands.name: VIEWRANGE
commands.summary: Plan view range relative to the level: Top, Cut plane, Bottom and View depth; elements above the top are left out and those below the bottom (down to the view depth, also from lower levels) are drawn as beyond. Off restores the default.
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Grids, Zones & Data ▸ View Range

commands.name: UNDERLAY
commands.summary: Shows another level halftone under the current plan (None to turn off).
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Grids, Zones & Data ▸ Underlay

commands.name: REVEALHIDDEN
commands.summary: Reveal hidden elements: On draws temporarily hidden objects in magenta, Off stops, Unhide restores objects by id (#12,#15) or All.

commands.name: TEMPHIDE
commands.summary: Temporarily hides the selected elements, or a whole Category (wall, door, component…) on the current level; UNISOLATEOBJECTS or REVEALHIDDEN Unhide restores them.

commands.name: TEMPISOLATE
commands.summary: Temporarily isolates element categories on the current level: every other category is hidden until UNISOLATEOBJECTS.

commands.name: GEOLOCATION
commands.summary: Project geolocation: City preset, or Set latitude, longitude, site elevation, time zone and true north (used by sun studies, energy and exports); List shows it.
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Grids, Zones & Data ▸ Geolocation

commands.name: ROOFSHAPE
commands.summary: Changes roofs into Mansard or Gambrel (two pitches with a break) forms, a Dome or a Barrel vault, or back to Plain.
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Grids, Zones & Data ▸ Roof by Shape

commands.name: ESCALATOR
commands.summary: Places an escalator from its bottom comb in a travel direction up to the level above (30°/35°, step width 600/800/1000), checks EN 115 rise/inclination/speed rules and cuts the upper floor; Check re-validates existing escalators.
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Grids, Zones & Data ▸ Escalator

commands.name: SECTIONOBJECT
commands.summary: Section plane objects: Add a named vertical plane (its plan trace can be moved), make it Live (clips the 3D view with caps), Flip, Generate/update its 2D section block, Slice solids into closed halves, List, Off, Delete.
entries: Tools ▸ 3D Primitives & Solid Tools ▸ Section Object

commands.name: MEPSYSTEM
commands.summary: Connector-based systems: list connected networks, assign a system to a whole network, show only some systems, or check open ends.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Authoring ▸ MEP Systems

commands.name: LIGHTDATA
commands.summary: Sets photometric data of light fixtures (lumens, watts, colour temperature, beam angle) used by schedules and rendering.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Authoring ▸ Light Data

commands.name: LIGHTSCHEDULE
commands.summary: Lighting fixture schedule (mark, type, level, room, position, rotation, lm, W, K) and average illuminance per room.

commands.name: AREASCHEME
commands.summary: Area schemes (GEA, GIA, NIA, DIN 277 BGF/NRF, Gross, Rentable): places associative area boundaries that follow the walls, lists schemes and reports totals.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Authoring ▸ Area Scheme

commands.name: AUTODIMGRIDS
commands.summary: Associative dimension string across parallel grid lines (bay dimensions and overall), updated when grids move.
entries: Annotate ▸ More ▸ Text ▸ Annotation Extras ▸ Grid Dimensions

commands.name: BIMUPDATE
commands.summary: Regenerates associative content: area boundaries, automatic dimensions, associative sweeps and family instances.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Authoring ▸ Update Associative

commands.name: FAMILY
commands.summary: Family editor: new family, parameters and formulas, forms (box, cylinder, extrusion, sweep, revolve, void, nested, arrays), types, place instances, set instance values, flex, door/window builder, assign to openings.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Authoring ▸ Family Editor

commands.name: PROFILE
commands.summary: Profile families for sweeps, handrails, gutters and mullions: list, create from a closed polyline (flexes with Width/Height), or delete.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ BIM Authoring ▸ Profiles

commands.name: VIEWTEMPLATE
commands.summary: View templates: list, apply to the current view, capture the current settings as a template, set a template value, apply to a placed drawing view, or delete.
entries: View ▸ More ▸ View ▸ Views & Graphics ▸ View Templates

commands.name: LEGEND
commands.summary: Places a legend view: wall types, door/window types, floor/roof build-ups, components or materials (VIEWUPDATE refreshes it).
entries: View ▸ More ▸ View ▸ Views & Graphics ▸ Legend

commands.name: DRAFTINGVIEW
commands.summary: Drafting views (2D only, not tied to the model): new, edit in isolation, close (store), place in the drawing, list.
entries: View ▸ More ▸ View ▸ Views & Graphics ▸ Drafting View

commands.name: VIEWGRAPHICS
commands.summary: View graphics: Categories (visibility/graphics overrides per category), Filters (rule-based view filters), Detail level, and Section/elevation graphics (line weights by depth, hidden lines, depth cueing, far clip, dimensions).
entries: View ▸ More ▸ View ▸ Views & Graphics ▸ View Graphics

commands.name: CORNERWINDOW
commands.summary: Corner window wrapping the corner of two walls: widths along each wall from the corner, height and sill; the walls are cut through the corner and the glazing meets at a slim post.
entries: Tools ▸ Adaptive, Corners & Roofs ▸ Corner Window

commands.name: ROOFJOIN
commands.summary: Joins a roof to another: the picked edge is extended until the roof meets the other roof and the part below it is cut away (Unjoin restores it).
entries: Tools ▸ Adaptive, Corners & Roofs ▸ Roof Join

commands.name: REBAR
commands.summary: Reinforcement in a concrete beam (Bottom/Top bars, Links), column (Vertical bars, Links) or slab (X/Y mesh): cover, bar diameter, count or spacing, BS 8666 shape codes; List prints the bar schedule.

commands.name: STEELCONNECTION
commands.summary: Steel connections sized from the member section: Base plate with anchor bolts or Cap plate on a column, End plate with bolts on a beam end; they follow the member.
entries: Tools ▸ Images, Links & Structure ▸ Steel Connection

commands.name: OBJECTSTYLES
commands.summary: Object styles: project-wide projection/cut line weights, line colour, cut fill and cut pattern per BIM category (wall, door, window, slab, column…); every plan and section follows. List, Reset, or set e.g. "cut:0.7;proj:0.35;color:red;fill:0.3,0.3,0.3;pattern:ANSI31".
entries: Tools ▸ Styles, Patterns & Occlusion ▸ Object Styles (command)

commands.name: AMBIENTOCCLUSION
commands.summary: Ambient occlusion baked on the model: Intensity (0 = off … 2), Radius and Samples; shaded elevations, sections, axonometrics and perspectives (and their PDF/SVG exports) darken corners and overhangs; Report prints the average occlusion.
entries: Tools ▸ Styles, Patterns & Occlusion ▸ Ambient Occlusion (command)

commands.name: WALLRECT
commands.summary: Draws four joined walls around a rectangle (two corners; Justify sets whether the rectangle is the inside, centre or outside face).
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Types & Parameters ▸ Rectangular Walls

commands.name: WALLPOLYGON
commands.summary: Draws a closed loop of joined walls: a regular polygon (centre, sides, radius), points, or a picked closed polyline.
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Types & Parameters ▸ Polygon Walls

commands.name: STOREFRONT
commands.summary: Storefront curtain walls (bays, transom, capped mullions, entrance door) or glazed Partitions (slim mullions, full-height door).

commands.name: STACKEDWALL
commands.summary: Makes walls stacked walls: segments of wall types bottom-up ("Type:height; Type:*"), regenerated when the base wall changes; Off removes the stack.
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Types & Parameters ▸ Stacked Wall

commands.name: PARTS
commands.summary: Divides compound walls into parts (one per layer, cut by the host's openings), Merge restores the wall, Material overrides a part, Show Parts/Original.

commands.name: ASSEMBLY
commands.summary: Assemblies (element aggregation): Create from selected elements, Add, Remove, Disassemble, Views (isolated plan and 3D views), List.

commands.name: STORY
commands.summary: Storey settings: Height (moves the storeys above), Insert above / below, Delete, Computation height (walls that bound rooms), Elevation display (project / survey / relative), List.
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Types & Parameters ▸ Story Settings

commands.name: STRUCTCOLUMN
commands.summary: Places structural columns with a profile (HEA/IPE/RHS/CHS… or RECT / ROUND concrete), from the level to the next level (or a height), at points or at every grid intersection.
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Types & Parameters ▸ Structural Column

commands.name: STRUCTURAL
commands.summary: Structural usage of walls, slabs, columns and beams: Bearing, Shear, Combined or Non-bearing (drives the analytical model and schedules).
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Types & Parameters ▸ Structural Usage

commands.name: STAIRTYPE
commands.summary: Stair types (max riser, min going, width, landing, material, railing type): New / Edit (every stair of the type follows), Assign to stairs, List, Delete.
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Types & Parameters ▸ Stair Types

commands.name: RAILTYPEDEF
commands.summary: Named railing types (height, handrail profile and size, infill, balusters, posts, extensions): New / Edit (railings of the type follow), Assign, List, Delete.
entries: Tools ▸ BIM Types & Parameters ▸ Railing Types

commands.name: EXPRESSION

commands.summary: Shows all objects hidden by HIDEOBJECTS or ISOLATEOBJECTS.

commands.summary: Controls the UCS icon: ON, OFF, Noorigin (lower-left corner) or ORigin (at the UCS origin when visible).

commands.summary: Shows the plan view of the current UCS, a named UCS or the world (rotates the 2D display so the UCS X axis is horizontal).

commands.name: RECOVERYFILES

commands.name: JOURNAL
commands.summary: Change journal for crash recovery: On (record every change every n seconds to the recovery folder), Off, Now (record immediately), Status.

commands.name: MODELMERGE
commands.summary: Three-way merge: combines another branch of the drawing (theirs) into this one using their common ancestor (base); non-conflicting changes of both sides are kept, conflicts keep ours and are listed.

commands.name: STANDARDS
