commands.summary: Finds the sync-conflict copies of the drawing (iCloud Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive…) and merges them in (three-way, nothing lost; true conflicts keep yours and are listed); merged copies move to <name>.archi-conflicts/.

commands.name: DGNIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports a MicroStation V7 .dgn file (lines, line strings, shapes, curves, circles, ellipses, arcs, text; levels become layers).
entries: Tools ▸ Import, Export & Collaboration ▸ Import DGN

commands.name: DGNEXPORT
commands.summary: Exports the drawing's 2D objects as a MicroStation V7 .dgn file (one level per layer, master units m, resolution 0.1 mm).
entries: Tools ▸ Import, Export & Collaboration ▸ Export DGN

commands.name: DWFIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports the sheets of a DWFx file (XPS paths, colours, line weights and text; one sheet after the other) as drawing objects.
entries: Tools ▸ Import, Export & Collaboration ▸ Import DWFx

commands.name: DOCSITE
commands.summary: Writes the documentation (user guide, scripting, agent API, command reference) as an offline HTML site with search.
entries: Tools ▸ Studies, Signatures & Publishing ▸ Documentation Site

commands.name: DWGIN
commands.summary: Imports a DWG drawing through an installed converter (ODA File Converter or LibreDWG); explains how to get one if none is installed.
entries: Insert ▸ More ▸ Exchange ▸ Import & Export ▸ DWG In

commands.name: DWGOUT
commands.summary: Writes a DWG file (DXF converted by the installed ODA File Converter or LibreDWG).
entries: Insert ▸ More ▸ Exchange ▸ Import & Export ▸ DWG Out

commands.name: DWGCONVERTER
commands.summary: Shows or sets the DWG converter used by DWGIN/DWGOUT (path to ODAFileConverter or dwg2dxf; stored in the drawing).
entries: Insert ▸ More ▸ Exchange ▸ Import & Export ▸ DWG Converter

commands.name: STEPIN
commands.summary: Imports polyhedral geometry from a STEP (AP203/AP214/AP242) file as mesh solids (planar faces; curved B-rep surfaces are skipped).
entries: Insert ▸ More ▸ Exchange ▸ Import & Export ▸ STEP In

commands.name: STEPOUT
commands.summary: Exports the 3D model as STEP AP214 faceted B-reps (one solid per element, millimetres, with colours).
entries: Insert ▸ More ▸ Exchange ▸ Import & Export ▸ STEP Out

commands.name: PLYOUT
commands.summary: Exports the 3D model as an ASCII PLY mesh (millimetres, Z up, vertex colours from materials).
entries: Insert ▸ More ▸ Exchange ▸ Import & Export ▸ PLY

commands.name: POINTCLOUDIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports a point cloud (XYZ, PTS or PLY ASCII/binary) as point entities with colours, decimated to a point budget and/or a voxel grid.
entries: Insert ▸ More ▸ Exchange ▸ Import & Export ▸ Point Cloud

commands.name: SHPIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports an ESRI shapefile (.shp with .dbf attributes and .prj CRS: WGS84, UTM, Web Mercator) as points/polylines; elevation attributes become contour elevations.
entries: Insert ▸ More ▸ Exchange ▸ Import & Export ▸ Shapefile

commands.name: OSMIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports an OpenStreetMap .osm extract around the project location: building outlines (optionally extruded to their height), roads, water and areas.
entries: Insert ▸ More ▸ Exchange ▸ Import & Export ▸ OpenStreetMap

commands.name: DEMIMPORT
commands.summary: Creates a toposurface from an ESRI ASCII elevation grid (.asc, metres), subsampled to a point budget.
entries: Architecture ▸ More ▸ Systems ▸ Site ▸ Import DEM

commands.name: HPGLOUT
commands.summary: Writes the current level's plan as HP-GL/2 (.plt) for plotters and cutters, at a plot scale.
entries: Insert ▸ More ▸ Exchange ▸ Import & Export ▸ HPGL

commands.name: XLSXOUT
commands.summary: Writes the schedules (walls, doors, windows, rooms, slabs, takeoff, areas by level) to an Excel .xlsx workbook.
entries: Insert ▸ More ▸ Exchange ▸ Import & Export ▸ Excel Out

commands.name: XLSXIN
commands.summary: Places the sheets of an .xlsx workbook as table entities.
entries: Insert ▸ More ▸ Exchange ▸ Import & Export ▸ Excel In

commands.name: IFCZIPOUT
commands.summary: Exports the model as IfcZIP (compressed IFC4).
entries: Insert ▸ More ▸ Exchange ▸ Import & Export ▸ IFC ZIP

commands.name: GBXMLOUT
commands.summary: Exports the energy model as gbXML 0.37: spaces, exterior/interior walls with windows and doors, roofs, floors, constructions with U-values.
entries: Insert ▸ More ▸ Exchange ▸ Import & Export ▸ gbXML

commands.name: COBIEOUT
commands.summary: Exports a COBie 2.4 spreadsheet (.xlsx): contact, facility, floors, spaces, types, components (doors, windows, equipment) and attributes.
entries: Insert ▸ More ▸ Exchange ▸ Import & Export ▸ COBie

commands.name: DAEOUT
commands.summary: Exports the 3D model as COLLADA 1.4.1 (.dae, metres, Z up, Phong materials).
entries: Insert ▸ More ▸ Exchange ▸ Import & Export ▸ Collada

commands.name: CITYJSONIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports a CityJSON city model (buildings, terrain, roads … at their highest LoD) as mesh solids per city object with attributes.
entries: Insert ▸ More ▸ Exchange ▸ Import & Export ▸ CityJSON

commands.name: IDSCHECK
commands.summary: Checks the model's IFC export (or an IFC file) against an Information Delivery Specification (.ids): entity, attribute, property and material requirements.
entries: Analyze ▸ Building Physics ▸ More ▸ Analysis & Checks ▸ IDS Check

commands.name: IMPORTFILE
commands.summary: Imports a file by extension: .archi, .dxf, .ifc, .svg, .obj, .stl, .3mf, .geojson, .csv/.txt/.xyz points.

commands.name: IFCIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports an IFC (IFC2x3/IFC4) model: walls, slabs, columns, beams, doors, windows and spaces become BIM elements; other products become meshes.

commands.name: SVGIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports SVG paths, lines, polylines, polygons, circles, ellipses, rectangles and text as drawing entities.

commands.name: MESHIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports an OBJ, STL, 3MF, glTF/GLB, PLY, OFF, AMF or COLLADA (.dae) file as mesh solids (choose the file's units where the format has none).

commands.name: GEOJSONIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports GeoJSON features (WGS84 lon/lat are projected around the project location; projected metres are used as-is).

commands.name: GEOJSONEXPORT
commands.summary: Exports 2D entities (selection or all) as GeoJSON in WGS84 or local metres.

commands.name: POINTSIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports survey points from CSV/TSV/TXT (X,Y[,Z][,name] with or without header, or P,N,E,Z,D).

commands.name: POINTSEXPORT
commands.summary: Writes point entities (selection or all) to CSV: name,x,y,z,code,layer.

commands.name: EXPORT3MF
commands.summary: Exports the 3D model as a 3MF package (millimetres, one object per element).

commands.name: USDEXPORT
commands.summary: Exports the 3D model as USD: .usda text or .usdz package (UsdPreviewSurface materials).

commands.name: DXFOUTVERSION
commands.summary: Writes an ASCII DXF of a chosen version: R12, R2000, R2004, R2007, R2010, R2013 or R2018 (AC1032, UTF-8 text).
entries: Tools ▸ Exchange Options ▸ DXF Output Version

commands.name: IFCXMLOUT
commands.summary: Exports the building model as ifcXML (IFC4, ISO 10303-28 XML encoding); a .zip or .ifczip name writes an IfcZIP holding the ifcXML.

commands.name: LAZCONVERTER
commands.summary: Shows or sets the LAZ decompressor used to import .laz point clouds (laszip, pdal or las2las; stored in the drawing).
entries: Tools ▸ Studies, Signatures & Publishing ▸ LAZ Converter

commands.name: DXFR12OUT
commands.summary: Writes a DXF R12 (AC1009) file for older CAD/CAM software (splines, ellipses, hatches and MText are converted).

commands.name: LASEREXPORT
commands.summary: Exports outlines for laser cutters / CNC as a true-size SVG in mm: joined continuous paths, red = cut, blue = engrave (layers *ENGRAV*/*SCORE*/*ETCH* or blue objects), optional model scale and kerf compensation.
entries: Tools ▸ Import, Export & Collaboration ▸ Laser Export

commands.name: SAVECOPY
commands.summary: Saves a copy of the drawing under another name or format (.archi, .architemplate, .dxf, .ifc, …); the open drawing keeps its name and unsaved state.
entries: Tools ▸ File Tools & Exchange ▸ Save a Copy

commands.name: UPGRADEFILE
commands.summary: Upgrades older .archi / .architemplate files (a file or every file in a folder) to the current format, keeping the originals as .vN.archi.bak.
entries: Tools ▸ File Tools & Exchange ▸ Upgrade File

commands.name: SAVECHECK
commands.summary: Verifies that saving and reopening the drawing gives an identical document (lists any section that would change).
entries: Tools ▸ File Tools & Exchange ▸ Round-trip Check

commands.name: TEMPLATEOUT
commands.summary: Writes the drawing as a template file (.architemplate) with a name and description; everything in the drawing is kept.
entries: Tools ▸ File Tools & Exchange ▸ Save as Template File

commands.name: TEMPLATEIN
commands.summary: Replaces the drawing with a new untitled drawing started from a template file (undoable).
entries: Tools ▸ File Tools & Exchange ▸ New from Template File

commands.name: FILEMETADATA
commands.summary: Lists the Spotlight metadata of the drawing or a file (title, authors, layers, levels, rooms, searchable text).
entries: Tools ▸ File Tools & Exchange ▸ File Metadata

commands.name: PDFATTACH
commands.summary: Attaches a PDF page as an underlay (by reference, faded and locked, with object snaps on its geometry) at a drawing scale and insertion point.
entries: Tools ▸ File Tools & Exchange ▸ Attach PDF

commands.name: PDFUNDERLAYS
commands.summary: Manages PDF underlays: List, Reload (re-read changed PDFs), Detach, Fade (0–90 %).
entries: Tools ▸ File Tools & Exchange ▸ PDF Underlays

commands.name: DROPIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports files as if dropped on the canvas: images and PDFs are attached, vector/3D exchange formats merged, side by side from a point.
entries: Tools ▸ File Tools & Exchange ▸ Import Dropped File

commands.name: BREPOUT
commands.summary: Exports the 3D model as an OpenCASCADE BREP file (shells of planar faces, millimetres) for FreeCAD, Salome and other OCCT tools.
entries: Tools ▸ File Tools & Exchange ▸ BREP Out

commands.name: BREPIN
commands.summary: Imports an OpenCASCADE BREP file (FreeCAD .brep/.brp) as mesh solids: stored triangulations are used, other faces are triangulated from their edges.
entries: Tools ▸ File Tools & Exchange ▸ BREP In

commands.name: E57IN
commands.summary: Imports an ASTM E57 point cloud (all scans, poses applied, colour and intensity) as points.
entries: Tools ▸ File Tools & Exchange ▸ E57 Scan In

commands.name: E57OUT
commands.summary: Exports the drawing's points (with their z, colour and intensity) as an ASTM E57 point cloud.
entries: Tools ▸ File Tools & Exchange ▸ E57 Scan Out

commands.name: ETRANSMIT
commands.summary: Packs the drawing with its referenced images, material textures and external references (paths rewritten) and a transmittal report into a ZIP.

commands.name: BATCH
commands.summary: Runs a JSON batch job file over many drawings: open/import, command lines or a script, outputs in any export format, analysis reports and save (the open drawing is not changed).

commands.name: KMLOUT
commands.summary: Exports KML or KMZ placed at the project location (GEOGRAPHICLOCATION / project latitude, longitude, north angle): extruded walls, slabs, roofs and rooms by level, linework by layer; KMZ also carries the 3D model (COLLADA).
entries: Insert ▸ Images & Geo ▸ KML / KMZ Out
Tools ▸ Images & Geo ▸ KML / KMZ Out

commands.name: SVGLAYERSOUT
commands.summary: Exports the current level's plan as SVG with one group (Inkscape/Illustrator layer) per drawing layer.
entries: Insert ▸ Images & Geo ▸ Layered SVG Out
Tools ▸ Images & Geo ▸ Layered SVG Out

commands.name: IMAGEIMPORT
commands.summary: Inserts a PNG/JPEG/GIF/BMP/TIFF/WebP image at its pixel aspect ratio; with a world file (.pgw/.jgw/.tfw/.wld) it is georeferenced (world units WORLDUNITMM, local origin GEOORIGIN).

commands.name: IMAGESCALE
commands.summary: Calibrates an image: pick two points on it and enter their real distance; the image is scaled about the first point.

commands.name: EXCHANGECHECK
commands.summary: Checks the gbXML or COBie export (or a given file) against the schema's required elements, enumerations and references.

commands.name: PDFIMPORT
commands.summary: Imports the vectors and text of a PDF page as drawing objects: paths with their colours and line widths, fills as solid hatches, text (ToUnicode aware), PDF layers (optional content) as layers; at a drawing scale and insertion point.
entries: Tools ▸ Import, Export & Collaboration ▸ Import PDF

commands.name: PDFMARKUPS
commands.summary: Imports the comments of a PDF page (notes, clouds/rectangles, ink, lines, highlights) as review markups with author and date, placed with the plot scale and origin and linked to the elements under them.
entries: Tools ▸ Import, Export & Collaboration ▸ PDF Markups

commands.name: POINTCLOUDVIEW
commands.summary: Point cloud display: Clip to a section box (min/max corners with Z range), Density (octree level of detail: keep at most N points shown, evenly over the cloud), Reset (show all). Hidden points move to layer POINTCLOUD-HIDDEN.
entries: Tools ▸ Import, Export & Collaboration ▸ Point Cloud View

commands.name: PCPLANE
commands.summary: Snaps to the scan point nearest a picked location and fits the plane through its neighbours: reports the point, normal, slope and fit error; a vertical plane is drawn as a line along its trace in plan.
entries: Tools ▸ Import, Export & Collaboration ▸ Point Cloud Plane

commands.name: SCANTOBIM
commands.summary: Detects planes in the point cloud (RANSAC) and creates walls from vertical planes and floor slabs from horizontal planes.
entries: Tools ▸ Import, Export & Collaboration ▸ Scan to BIM

commands.name: PRESENTOUT
commands.summary: Writes the sheets and saved views as a self-contained HTML slide show (full screen with F, arrow keys, speaker notes from the sheet field 'notes').
entries: Tools ▸ Studies, Signatures & Publishing ▸ Presentation Out

commands.name: RHINOIN
commands.summary: Imports a Rhino .3dm file (versions 2–8): meshes, B-reps (render meshes or tessellated trimmed faces), extrusions, surfaces, curves, points and blocks, with layers, colours, materials and units.

commands.name: RHINOOUT
commands.summary: Exports a Rhino .3dm (version 4) file in the drawing units: the 3D model as meshes coloured by material, drafting curves as exact lines, arcs, polylines and NURBS, with layers.

commands.name: SIGNKEY
commands.summary: Creates (or shows) your Ed25519 signing key, kept in Application Support; prints the public key others add to TRUSTEDSIGNERS.
entries: Tools ▸ Studies, Signatures & Publishing ▸ Signing Key

commands.name: SIGNFILE
commands.summary: Signs a file (PDF, DWG, IFC, the drawing…) with your key: writes a detached <file>.sig with the signer, time, SHA-256 and Ed25519 signature.
entries: Tools ▸ Studies, Signatures & Publishing ▸ Sign File

commands.name: VERIFYSIGNATURE
commands.summary: Checks a file against its <file>.sig: valid signature, unchanged content, and whether the signer is trusted (TRUSTEDSIGNERS).
entries: Tools ▸ Studies, Signatures & Publishing ▸ Verify Signature

commands.name: TRUSTSIGNER
commands.summary: Adds a signer's public key (or the key of a .sig file) to the drawing's trusted signers.
entries: Tools ▸ Studies, Signatures & Publishing ▸ Trust Signer

commands.name: SURVEYLINES
commands.summary: Survey field-to-finish: joins survey points into polylines by their codes (EP1 B … EP1 E, C to close) and moves points to the feature layers of the description keys (variable SURVEYCODES: EP=V-ROAD-EDGE:line; TREE=V-TREE:point).
entries: Tools ▸ Studies, Signatures & Publishing ▸ Survey Linework

commands.name: TRACEREVIEW
commands.summary: Trace review overlays: New (named overlay layer over the drawing, linked to the view and selected elements), Enter/Exit (draw on it), Show/Hide, Zoom (restores its view and selects its elements), List, Close, Import (merge its sketches into the drawing), Delete.
entries: Tools ▸ Import, Export & Collaboration ▸ Trace Review

commands.name: SHAREVIEW
commands.summary: Exports a read-only, self-contained HTML viewer (all level plans as vectors with pan/zoom, element info on click, room schedule, layer toggles) to share with people without the app.
entries: Tools ▸ Import, Export & Collaboration ▸ Share View

commands.name: MAKECOMPONENT
commands.summary: SketchUp-style component: the selected objects become a named definition and are replaced by an instance; every instance updates when the definition is edited (BEDIT/REFEDIT).

commands.name: MAKEGROUP
commands.summary: SketchUp-style group: the selected objects become one unique (unnamed) object that moves and copies as a whole.

commands.name: MAKEUNIQUE
commands.summary: Gives a component or group instance its own copy of the definition so it can be edited without changing the other instances.

commands.name: COMPONENTTOBIM
commands.summary: Converts component / group instances or solids into schedulable BIM component elements (category and name).
entries: Tools ▸ Components & Surfaces ▸ Component to BIM

commands.name: OUTLINER
commands.summary: Outliner: lists the hierarchy of groups, components and model groups; Select instances by name (wildcards), Rename an instance, or Convert it to a BIM element.

commands.name: DATUM
commands.summary: Reference geometry that follows its source: datum Plane (through a line, offset from a solid Face, or at a Level), Axis (along a line, through a circle centre or a cylinder) or Point (centre, start, end or midpoint).

commands.name: SANDBOX
commands.summary: Sandbox terrain tools: Grid (terrain from scratch), Smoove (raise/lower with falloff), Stamp (flat pad with side slopes), Drape (project curves onto the terrain), ToBIM (toposurface → BIM topography element).

commands.name: SOLIDHIST
commands.summary: Turns recording of the CSG feature history of solids on or off (booleans on solids with a history always record).
entries: Modeling ▸ Surfaces ▸ Surfaces ▸ Solid Features ▸ Record History

commands.name: SOLIDHISTORY
commands.summary: Feature list of a solid: list, suppress/unsuppress, delete or move a boolean feature (the solid regenerates), or flatten the history.
entries: Modeling ▸ Surfaces ▸ Surfaces ▸ Solid Features ▸ Feature History

commands.name: PRESSPULLFACE
commands.summary: Pushes or pulls a planar face (top, bottom or side) of any 3D solid along its normal.
entries: Modeling ▸ Surfaces ▸ Surfaces ▸ Solid Features ▸ Press/Pull Face

commands.name: SECTIONSOLIDS
commands.summary: Cuts 3D solids with a vertical section plane (two points) and places the 2D section (cut poché + projection) as a block; Plan cuts them horizontally.
entries: Modeling ▸ Surfaces ▸ Surfaces ▸ Solid Features ▸ Section Solids

commands.name: SHAPEBINDER
commands.summary: Sub-shape binder: an associative copy of another body (Solid) or of one of its faces (Face, as a surface), optionally displaced; it follows the source when that changes.

commands.name: SCALE3D
commands.summary: Non-uniform scale of solids about a base point: separate X, Y and Z factors (negative factors mirror), or Handles: drag a bounding-box handle (corner, edge midpoint, Top/Bottom) about the opposite side or the Center, optionally Uniform.

commands.name: CYLINDER
commands.summary: Creates a 3D solid cylinder: centre, 3P, 2P or Elliptical base; height, 2Point or Axis endpoint.

commands.name: EXTRUDE
commands.summary: Extrudes closed 2D objects into 3D solids: height, Direction (oblique), Path, Taper angle, Both sides (symmetric).

commands.name: REVOLVE
commands.summary: Revolves closed 2D objects about an axis into 3D solids (associative: the solid regenerates when the profile is edited; DELOBJ 1 deletes profiles).

commands.name: FOLLOWME
commands.summary: SketchUp-style follow me: sweeps a profile along a path keeping its position relative to the path start (x = offset left of the path, y = height); associative.

commands.name: SWEEP3D
commands.summary: Sweeps a closed profile (centred on the path) along a 3D path such as a helix (or a new Helix); associative with profile and path.
entries: Tools ▸ Feature Modelling ▸ Sweep along 3D Path

commands.name: PAD
commands.summary: PartDesign pad: extrudes a sketch profile (optionally tapered) and adds it to a solid, or creates a new body; regenerates when the sketch changes.

commands.name: POCKET
commands.summary: PartDesign pocket: cuts a sketch profile into a solid by a depth (downwards from the sketch) or Through all; regenerates when the sketch changes.

commands.name: HOLE
commands.summary: Hole features at sketch points or circles: diameter, depth or Through, Simple / Counterbore / Countersink, optional thread designation; follow their sketch.

commands.name: PATTERNFEATURE
commands.summary: Repeats a feature (or the whole body) in a Linear (columns × rows) or Polar pattern; instances follow the feature's sketch.

commands.name: MIRRORFEATURE
commands.summary: Mirrors a feature (or the whole body) about a vertical plane through two points or the XY plane at a height; stays parametric.

commands.name: SPLITSOLID
commands.summary: Splits solids by other solids into the parts inside and outside the tools (separate bodies).

commands.name: GFUSE
commands.summary: General fuse: cuts overlapping solids into non-overlapping pieces (overlaps become their own solids).

commands.name: SOLIDEDIT
commands.summary: Edits solid faces: Extrude, Move, Offset, Taper or Copy a face (picked Top/Bottom/Side in plan); Body Offset or Separate.

commands.name: OFFSETSOLID
commands.summary: Offsets solids: every face moves outwards (or inwards, negative) by the distance.

commands.name: CSGTREE
commands.summary: BRL-CAD style combination: 'u #1 - #2 + #3 u #4' (u union, - subtract, + intersect); the result regenerates when a member changes. List / Edit existing trees.

commands.name: MECHANISM
commands.summary: Mechanism simulation: steps a named driving dimension (angles in degrees) through a range, re-solving the constraints each step; draws the path of a traced point, optional ghost poses, reports lock-up and the range of other dimensions.
entries: Tools ▸ Adaptive, Corners & Roofs ▸ Mechanism Simulation

commands.name: UNION
commands.summary: Combines selected 3D solids into one.

commands.name: SUBTRACT
commands.summary: Subtracts solids from other solids.

commands.name: INTERSECT
commands.summary: Keeps only the common volume of the selected solids.

commands.name: SLICE
commands.summary: Cuts solids with a vertical plane through two points or a horizontal plane (XY) at a height.

commands.name: INTERFERE
commands.summary: Finds overlapping volumes between two sets of solids and can create them as new solids.

commands.name: PRESSPULL
commands.summary: Extrudes the area around a picked point (with islands as holes), a closed object, or changes an extrusion's height.

commands.name: LOFT
commands.summary: Creates a solid through closed cross-sections at given heights (in selection order).

commands.name: SWEEP
commands.summary: Sweeps closed profiles along a path (profile X to the left of travel, Y up).

commands.name: PIPE
commands.summary: Creates a round pipe (optionally hollow) along a path.

commands.name: TOPO
commands.summary: Creates a toposurface from points (with elevations), contour polylines (picked, or every object on contour Layers of an imported DXF), an XYZ/CSV file or typed x,y,z values.

commands.name: CONTOURS
commands.summary: Sets the contour interval and major-line spacing of toposurfaces (0 = hide contours).

commands.name: BUILDINGPAD
commands.summary: Levels a toposurface inside a boundary to a pad elevation (cut and fill).

commands.name: PROJECTGEOMETRY
commands.summary: Projects the outline of solids onto the sketch plane as closed polylines that follow the solids when they change (use them as sketch profiles).

commands.name: INTERSECTFACES
commands.summary: SketchUp intersect faces: draws 3D edges (polylines) where the selected solids cut each other, or cut the rest of the Model.

commands.name: PAINT
commands.summary: Paint bucket: applies a material to objects and building elements by clicking them; Sample picks up an object's material; List shows the materials.

commands.name: SOFTEN
commands.summary: Softens and smooths the edges of solids/meshes whose faces meet at less than an angle (0 = sharp again); display only.

commands.name: TAPEMEASURE
commands.summary: Tape measure: Measure between two points, create a Guide parallel to an edge at a distance or through a point, or a Protractor guide at an angle.

commands.name: MESH
commands.summary: Faceted mesh primitives with divisions (MESHDIVISIONS): Box, Cylinder, Cone, Sphere, Torus, Wedge, Pyramid.
entries: Tools ▸ 3D Primitives & Solid Tools ▸ Mesh Primitive

commands.name: CONVTOMESH
commands.summary: Converts parametric solids (box, cylinder, extrusion, revolve…) into editable triangle meshes.
entries: Tools ▸ 3D Primitives & Solid Tools ▸ Convert to Mesh

commands.name: CONVTOSOLID
commands.summary: Converts closed meshes into solids (cleaned and oriented); open meshes are refused (MESHREPAIR can close them).
entries: Tools ▸ 3D Primitives & Solid Tools ▸ Convert to Solid

commands.name: LINEAREXTRUDE
commands.summary: OpenSCAD-style linear extrude of closed profiles: height, twist angle and top scale (slices follow the twist).
entries: Tools ▸ 3D Primitives & Solid Tools ▸ Linear Extrude

commands.name: WEDGE
commands.summary: Creates a wedge solid: base rectangle by two corners (or Length), height; the top slopes down along X.

commands.name: PYRAMID
commands.summary: Creates a pyramid or frustum with N sides: base centre, base radius, height (Top radius for a frustum).

commands.name: TORUS
commands.summary: Creates a torus: centre, radius of the torus, radius of the tube.

commands.name: PRISM
commands.summary: Regular prism (N sides) or tube (inner radius > 0): centre, circumradius, height.

commands.name: POLYHEDRON
commands.summary: Solid from points (x,y,z) and faces (point numbers from 1, e.g. 1,2,3,4) like OpenSCAD polyhedron().

commands.name: POLYSOLID
commands.summary: Draws a wall-like solid along points or converts a line/polyline/arc (Object); Height, Width, Justify.

commands.name: HULL
commands.summary: Convex hull solid of the selected solids (and points/curves at their elevation), like OpenSCAD hull().
entries: Tools ▸ 3D Primitives & Solid Tools ▸ Convex Hull

commands.name: THICKEN
commands.summary: Turns surfaces into solids by offsetting them along their normals (negative = other side).

commands.name: PLANESURF
commands.summary: Planar surface from a closed boundary (Object, with inner loops as holes) or from two corners of a rectangle.
entries: Tools ▸ 3D Primitives & Solid Tools ▸ Planar Surface

commands.name: SEPARATE
commands.summary: Separates solids into their disjoint bodies and cleans them (duplicate/degenerate faces, consistent outward orientation).
entries: Tools ▸ 3D Primitives & Solid Tools ▸ Separate Solids

commands.name: SOLIDCHECK
commands.summary: Validates solids: open or non-manifold edges, inconsistent orientation, degenerate faces, volume and bodies.
entries: Tools ▸ 3D Primitives & Solid Tools ▸ Check Solid

commands.name: 3DALIGN
commands.summary: Aligns solids in 3D by up to three source and destination points (translation, then direction, then plane); optional scaling.

commands.name: MESHEXTRUDE
commands.summary: Extrudes faces of a solid or mesh (the faces facing Top/Bottom/Front/Back/Left/Right under a picked point, or All facing that way) by a distance along their normal; the result stays closed.
entries: Tools ▸ Mesh & Procedural 3D ▸ Extrude Mesh Face

commands.name: WIREFRAME
commands.summary: Wireframe modifier: turns the edges of a solid or mesh into struts of a given thickness (Solidify: THICKEN).

commands.name: UNFOLD
commands.summary: Unfolds a solid or mesh into a flat net for fabrication (cut lines solid, fold lines dashed), placed at a point.

commands.name: MESHSECTION
commands.summary: Cross-sections of solids and meshes: section curves at one elevation or every interval between two elevations (for contours, ribs, waffle models).

commands.name: MINKOWSKI
commands.summary: Minkowski sum of two solids (e.g. a box and a sphere for rounded edges); exact for convex solids.

commands.name: SPRING
commands.summary: Creates a helical coil spring solid (coil radius, wire radius, pitch, turns).

commands.name: TEXT3D
commands.summary: Creates extruded 3D text (single-line font strokes as solid bars).

commands.name: SURFCV
commands.summary: B-spline (NURBS) surface from a grid of control vertices: New over a rectangle, Edit moves a CV (row, column, height), Display the CV grid.

commands.name: SCAD
commands.summary: Evaluates an OpenSCAD-language script (cube, sphere, cylinder, polyhedron, extrudes, transforms, union/difference/intersection/hull/minkowski, modules, loops) into a solid.

commands.name: SCADFILE
commands.summary: Imports an OpenSCAD .scad file (with include / use of neighbouring files) as a solid.

commands.name: SCADOBJECT
commands.summary: Scripted parametric objects (OpenSCAD language, GDL-like): New from a script or File, list Params (Customizer ranges and choices), Set a parameter to regenerate.

commands.name: SKETCHPLANE
commands.summary: Sketch environment: New sketch on a work plane (XY at an elevation, a solid Face, or vertical through a Line), Add objects drawn in sketch coordinates, Status (degrees of freedom — constrain with the geometric/dimensional constraints), List, Delete.
entries: Tools ▸ Adaptive, Corners & Roofs ▸ Sketch Plane

commands.name: SKETCHPAD
commands.summary: Pads a sketch: its closed profile (with holes) extruded along the work-plane normal; the solid follows every change of the sketch.
entries: Tools ▸ Adaptive, Corners & Roofs ▸ Sketch Environment

commands.name: SHELL
commands.summary: Hollows boxes and extrusions to a wall thickness, optionally removing the top face (SOLIDEDIT Shell).

commands.name: MESHSMOOTH
commands.summary: Smooths solids and meshes by Loop subdivision (1–4 levels).

commands.name: MIRROR3D
commands.summary: Mirrors solids about the XY, YZ or ZX plane through a point, or a vertical plane through two points.

commands.name: ROTATE3D
commands.summary: Rotates solids about an axis parallel to X, Y or Z through a point.

commands.name: 3DARRAY
commands.summary: Creates rectangular (rows × columns × levels) or polar 3D arrays of objects.

commands.name: CHAMFEREDGE
commands.summary: Bevels the edges of boxes and extruded solids (all, vertical, top or bottom edges).
entries: Modeling ▸ Surfaces ▸ Surfaces ▸ Surfaces & Mesh ▸ Chamfer Edges

commands.name: FILLETEDGE
commands.summary: Rounds the edges of boxes and extruded solids (all, vertical, top or bottom edges).
entries: Modeling ▸ Surfaces ▸ Surfaces ▸ Surfaces & Mesh ▸ Fillet Edges

commands.name: IMPRINT
commands.summary: Imprints curves (lines, polylines, arcs, circles, 3D polylines) onto a planar face of a solid: the face is split along them, the solid stays closed.

commands.name: OFFSETFACE
commands.summary: SketchUp-style Offset: imprints a copy of a planar face's edges offset into the face (then SUBOBJECT Extrude pushes or pulls the inner face).

commands.name: SUBOBJECT
commands.summary: Sub-object editing (Ctrl-click in the viewport): pick a Face, Edge or Vertex of a solid and Move it, Extrude a face, or list Info.

commands.name: SURFBLEND
commands.summary: Blend surface between the edges of two surfaces with G0 (position), G1 (tangent) or G2 (curvature) continuity and a bulge factor.

commands.name: SURFANALYSIS
commands.summary: Surface analysis: Zebra stripes, Curvature (Gaussian or mean, colour bands), Draft angle against a pull direction, Continuity between two surfaces, or Clear the analysis overlays.

commands.name: REVSURF
commands.summary: Revolved mesh surface: rotates a path curve about an axis line (start angle, included angle; SURFTAB1 segments).
entries: Modeling ▸ Surfaces ▸ Surfaces ▸ Surfaces & Mesh ▸ Revolved Surface

commands.name: TABSURF
commands.summary: Tabulated mesh surface: sweeps a path curve along a direction vector (a line) or straight up by a height.
entries: Modeling ▸ Surfaces ▸ Surfaces ▸ Surfaces & Mesh ▸ Tabulated Surface

commands.name: RULESURF
commands.summary: Ruled mesh surface between two curves (SURFTAB1 rulings).
entries: Modeling ▸ Surfaces ▸ Surfaces ▸ Surfaces & Mesh ▸ Ruled Surface

commands.name: EDGESURF
commands.summary: Coons patch mesh bounded by four edge curves that touch end to end (SURFTAB1 × SURFTAB2).
entries: Modeling ▸ Surfaces ▸ Surfaces ▸ Surfaces & Mesh ▸ Edge Surface

commands.name: MESHREPAIR
commands.summary: Repairs meshes/solids: welds vertices, removes degenerate and duplicate faces, fixes orientation, fills holes.
entries: Modeling ▸ Surfaces ▸ Surfaces ▸ Surfaces & Mesh ▸ Repair Mesh

commands.name: MESHDECIMATE
commands.summary: Reduces the triangle count of meshes/solids to a percentage (vertex clustering).
entries: Modeling ▸ Surfaces ▸ Surfaces ▸ Surfaces & Mesh ▸ Decimate Mesh

commands.name: SURFPATCH
commands.summary: Patch surface filling a closed boundary (one closed curve or curves meeting end to end; 3D polylines with vertexZ or elevations): planar boundaries exactly, others as a Coons patch.

commands.name: SURFNETWORK
commands.summary: Network surface through curves in the U and V directions (Gordon surface: passes through every curve).

commands.name: SURFSCULPT
commands.summary: Joins surfaces that enclose a watertight volume into a solid (the surfaces are replaced).
entries: Tools ▸ Freeform Surfaces ▸ Sculpt to Solid

commands.name: SURFOFFSET
commands.summary: Offset copy of surfaces along their normals.

commands.name: SURFEXTEND
commands.summary: Extends the outer edges of surfaces tangentially by a distance.

commands.name: SURFTRIM
commands.summary: Trims surfaces with a closed plan curve (projected vertically), keeping the part Inside or Outside.
